topic: Troubleshooting data aggregation and copying scripts
summary_markdown:
A user reported issues with both the aggregation script and the copying script not working. The issue was initially suspected to be related to drivers or DataGrip configuration, as suggested by another party. [me] advised checking if a post regarding the driver had been shared. Additionally, [me] recommended changing the File Resolve Mode on the editor toolbar from Playground to Script, suggesting it might improve functionality.

The user confirmed that the scripts were working after making this specific setting change.
decisions: The File Resolve Mode was changed from Playground to Script.
